training_2025_model: All LOW_VOL-L rows with decision_time before 2025-01-01 and exit_time at or before 2025-01-01.
overlap_weight: Unchanged 30-minute bucket inverse-count weighting multiplied by clipped absolute Strong R.

reference_distribution.component_reference: The complete 2024 LOW_VOL-L out-of-sample raw predictions from the frozen 2023 CatBoost specialist model.
reference_distribution.component_percentiles: Convert 2024 reference predictions and 2025 refit-model predictions to percentiles using the 2024 raw prediction distribution separately for probability and Strong-R prediction.
reference_distribution.threshold: 98th percentile of the 2024 reference score distribution, preserving the frozen two-percent retention fraction.

if_confirmation_fails: Reject the sleeve and do not use 2026 to rescue, retune or change retention.
if_confirmation_passes: Freeze the candidate and run 2026 as diagnostic only before any portfolio or live decision.
